titolo: NVIDIA launches Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB for local voice agents and robots
descr: NVIDIA announced the Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB model on 24 October 2026.
paragrafi: NVIDIA announced the Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB model on 24 October 2026.
The model is a post‑trained version of Gemma 4 E4B and is open for use.
It is designed to run on about 4 GB of VRAM, targeting NVIDIA RTX graphics cards and Jetson platforms.
Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B is positioned for local voice assistants, game characters and robotic applications.
The release adds another small, locally runnable LLM to the open‑source ecosystem.
perche: The model lets developers embed conversational AI on edge devices without cloud reliance. For users seeking free or locally hosted models, it offers a lightweight alternative to larger commercial offerings.
